chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Abi Jamilah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man forgets the adhan and the iqamah until he says the takbir. He said: He continues with his salat and does not repeat.

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before salat
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call announcing the immediate commencement of salat
key_terms.يُكَبِّرَ: to pronounce the opening takbir of the salat
key_terms.يُمْضِي: he continues and proceeds without interruption

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the adhan and iqamah until starting the salat, must he repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the adhan and iqamah until beginning the salat with takbir. The Imam عليه السلام states that he should continue his salat and is not required to repeat it.
